path.description: File, directory, or supported image path to read.

workdir.description: Working directory for resolving relative paths. Defaults to the agent's current working directory. If provided, relative paths resolve from that directory.

offset.description: Positive integer 1-based line offset for text reads. Defaults to 1.

limit.description: Positive integer maximum number of text lines to return. Defaults to 200 and must not exceed 2000.
